settings.content: If you have store in multi-language, you can enter multiple values separated by commas: Color,Colour,Couleur

Text shown wherever a "dynamic sale" toggle is enabled (announcement bar, image with text, etc), based on the current calendar month. Edit a month below and it updates everywhere dynamic sale is used.
Use [sale_name] anywhere in the templates below - it's replaced with the current month's sale name from above (in capitals).

settings.label: Announcement bar message
settings.default: 🎁 BUY 1 GET 1 FREE FOR [sale_name] SALE: NOW AVAILABLE

settings.label: Image with text heading
settings.info: HTML tags like <em> and <strong> are supported here, same as the regular heading field.

settings.content: Optional per-language overrides for duplicated market templates. Set a block's "Dynamic sale language code" setting (e.g. de, es, br) and add a matching key below - any language or field left out falls back to the English defaults above. Must be valid JSON.
